step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture displays an AI image cataloging processing and training pipeline. 1. External image uploads enter through Amazon API Gateway. 2. API Gateway routes requests to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). 3. ALB forwards traffic to Amazon ECS, which handles image parameters and metadata. 4. ECS pushes image processing jobs into Amazon SQS queues based on categories. 5. Amazon SQS feeds messages to the EC2 Processing layer (CPU for pre/post processing and G5 GPU instances for inference). 6. For training, Amazon SageMaker fetches input training data from Amazon S3. 7. Upon completion, SageMaker saves trained model weights back to Amazon S3. 8. SageMaker triggers an AWS Lambda function. 9. Lambda synchronizes the updated weights from S3 to the EC2 Processing layer.
